CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents was asserted; A is absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified with coordinate set and an explicit origin/status string for the same referent/time; an organization-like pattern is present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition was linked to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content labels (red/blue) are identified with coordinate value sets for named referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from the content coordinate lists, distinguishing identification from status/origin.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is organized/presented (coordinate sets, layout instruction), i.e., an explicit organizational/presentation pattern.
